jobs.title: Backend Engineer (Python / FastAPI)
jobs.description:
ABOUT PLANE

Plane’s mission is to build the infrastructure the world’s work runs on. We want teams to move faster without losing context, and organizations to retain the flexibility and control they need. Our team is building that work infrastructure as an open, adaptable platform for projects, knowledge, and requests—simple enough for any team to adopt and dependable enough for organizations to build on.

Plane began in public on [GitHub](https://github.com/makeplane/plane) at the end of 2022. Since then, it has grown from an open-source project into a work management platform used by teams around the world. Organizations can use Plane as a managed Cloud service, run it on their own infrastructure, or deploy it inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for what we ship.

We believe the future of work will be shaped by people and agents working together. That makes shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action more important—not less. Plane exists to make that future useful, legible, and within the organization's control.

Plane is backed by OSS Capital and built across San Francisco and Hyderabad. We work in small, collaborative teams, stay close to users, and care about both the visible product experience and the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end and add process only when it helps the work.

We are still early. If you want to help define what work infrastructure becomes—and build software that teams can make their own and organizations can depend on—we'd like to hear from you.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

This role is at the heart of building and scaling the API infrastructure that powers Plane's core platform. The Backend Engineer will lead the design and development of high-performance, production-grade APIs using FastAPI, while working alongside a team that values clean architecture, developer experience, and open-source impact. You will work with modern backend technologies — including asynchronous Python, event-driven systems, and advanced caching — to ensure our platform remains fast, reliable, and scalable as we grow.

BitGo is the leading infrastructure provider of digital asset solutions, delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since our founding in 2013, we have focused on enabling our clients to securely navigate the digital asset space. With a global presence and multiple Trust companies, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of retail investors worldwide. As the operational backbone of the digital economy, BitGo handles a significant portion of Bitcoin network transactions and is the largest independent digital asset custodian, and staking provider, in the world. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

BitGo is looking for a Data Scientist who will join our Data Science and Analytics Team and help us continuously refine the framework that supports our growing business and make data-driven decisions.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and standardize metrics and dashboards that would identify trends and generate hypotheses about the product through a deep understanding of the data, our customers, and our business
  • Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to implement reporting solutions driven by business requirements
  • Design experiments and interpret results to draw detailed and impactful conclusions
  • Develop and automate reporting of key performance indicators of various BitGo’s products and services at scale
  • Partner with product managers to design experiments to test hypothesis and help with idea generation and refinement
  • Collaborate with engineering teams and stakeholders to build and improve on the availability, integrity, accuracy, and reliability of data pipelines 
  • Be a data evangelist and help BitGo improve its products and services

jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Product Security Engineer (Level 1 / Level 2)

Experience: 4–5 years
Location: Bengaluru/Chennai (Hybrid)

About the Role

Every day, millions of people rely on NETGEAR products to connect their digital lives. As a Senior Product Security Engineer on the NETGEAR Product Security Team, you will play a hands-on role in securing our networking products by identifying vulnerabilities, strengthening secure development practices, and working closely with product engineering teams.

This role is ideal for a security engineer who has strong technical fundamentals and is ready to take increased ownership in product security initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

 - Work closely with NETGEAR product development teams to identify, analyze, remediate, and validate security vulnerabilities in software, firmware, and services.

 - Perform application and product security assessments, including code reviews, vulnerability analysis, and design reviews.

 - Help implement and improve security tooling such as SAST, SCA/OSS scanning, and CI/CD security checks.

jobs.description:
AI Infrastructure Engineer - Agent Sandbox Platform

As a Software Engineer on the AI Infrastructure team, you'll help build and evolve our agent sandboxing platform — the secure, high-performance code execution layer powering our agentic workflows, deployed across both internal and customer-managed environments. You'll build the evaluation systems that tell us whether Firecrawl actually works. That sounds simple. It isn't.
